title: Missing time on drive home from college

tellings.quote: about 2 and 1 half hours into it suddenly we found oursel in the middle of nowhere didn't know where we were didn't know how we got there and eventually looking at our watch we figured out that somehow we had been asleep for an hour and a half so this was a classic example of missing time

plain: On a drive home from college, Bob Maguire, who later worked as a CIA contractor, says that about two and a half hours in, he and his companion suddenly found themselves in the middle of nowhere, with no idea where they were or how they got there. Checking their watches, they worked out that an hour and a half was unaccounted for. Maguire tells Michels this himself and calls it "a classic example of missing time," the term UFO researchers use for hours that witnesses cannot account for, often linked to abductions.
